items.title: 67395_Vic Dickenson oral history interview
items.q: I was out on the West Coast with Eddie Heywood.

ctx.x: No. He just... They were on the road, I guess, and he...
Was it '47 he died, huh?! Well, that's right. In '47... Oh, in the Forties I was out West. That's why I didn't run into anybody. I was out on the West Coast with Eddie Heywood.
And I think... Now that you mention it, I think he may have been out on the road for a few months or something, when he wasn't feeling well, and then he came back, and then...you know...
